notes:
- The Live guide keeps the time you were browsing when you unfold or rotate the device. In-progress programme titles remain visible, and the filter shows your selected group.
- On wide touch screens, the player and programme details align side by side. Fullscreen is available from the video controls, and the Settings drawer dims the full backdrop.
- Live scores and followed events use centered carousels with fading edges on wide screens.
- Guide reminder synchronization retries interrupted database work. Picture-in-picture follows the active video surface when returning to the guide.

- Release builds now record their source commit.
